assumptions: Geometry is the source 60 mm x 300 micrometre x 12 mm cell; base flow 450 uL/min.
Density 786 kg/m3 follows the source assumption; viscosity 0.00035 Pa s and Cp 2200 J/(kg K) are selected scenarios, not verified mixture properties.
Pressure estimate is fully developed parallel-plate Newtonian flow; no entrance, tubing, sidewall correction, manifold, gas evolution or pump efficiency.
Voltage = 1.85 + 0.48 + 18.5 I is the source assumed lumped voltage law; not a solved potential or measured voltage.
Temperature rise allocates a selected fraction of electrical power to sensible heat, with no heat transfer or reaction enthalpy; not a thermal PDE, measured temperature or strict safety bound.
